rules.subject: PerformSource
rules.conclusion: RefComp<R>; Content under x:R; Discourse under read:RefComp<R>,o:ActOccurrence Assertion -> Discourse
rules.reason: General three-arm direct form; source-family eligibility and denotation remain supplied premises/outside typing.

rules.subject: Text
rules.reason: The Redex A0 slice omits Text literals, but the all-S1 primitive cohort contains sign constructors over Text.

rules.subject: first-order hierarchy
rules.conclusion: covariant declared subsorting plus singleton Referents lift
rules.reason: All-S1 typing must consume the live sort hierarchy instead of the numeric-only A0 compatibility fragment.

rules.subject: core inventory
rules.reason: The all-S1 primitive cohort reaches CurrentToken and the projective others constants in addition to A0's Speaker/Audience/TooManyK.

rules.subject: fixture lexical rows
rules.conclusion: row head plus arity/event mode -> typed residual PredTerm
rules.reason: The frozen corpus supplies lexical heads through the fixture; its row arity and event mode are consumed explicitly and remain pilot-only pending #12.

rules.subject: PredTerm
rules.conclusion: fill typed residual row; exhausted row -> Content
rules.reason: Primitive cases apply bound and lexical PredTerms, including labelled Eventuality fills.

rules.subject: Combine
rules.reason: The primitive baseline contains plural joins and singleton lifts.

rules.subject: membership
rules.reason: The primitive baseline contains set membership.

rules.subject: Assert/Mention/Do
rules.conclusion: Assert Content -> Act Assertion; Mention T -> Act Expressive; Do acts/performance/discourse -> Discourse
rules.reason: The primitive baseline exercises inert act construction and discourse sequencing.

rules.subject: LocutionOf
rules.reason: Three primitive gates discriminate the two argument types.

rules.subject: sign constructors
rules.reason: Primitive gates cover valid Text signs and wrong Text/reference/content operands.

rules.subject: Reify
rules.reason: Reification is inert and must not inherit the operand effects.

rules.subject: RealizedContent
rules.reason: The primitive baseline contains the token-to-captured-content projection.

rules.subject: DropPlace
rules.conclusion: PredTerm<row> x Label<row> -> PredTerm<RowMinus row label>
rules.reason: The primitive baseline contains one valid row deletion gate.

rules.subject: te'a
rules.reason: The primitive baseline contains an exponentiation/equality gate while the recursive expansion remains post-M2.

rules.subject: Aggregate
rules.reason: Recursive expansion of CanonicalAggregateAt reaches Aggregate.

rules.subject: BasisUnitAt
rules.conclusion: DecompositionBasis<W,C> x Referents<C> x Referents<C> -> Content
rules.reason: Recursive expansion of GunmaAt reaches the basis interface.

rules.subject: PeerUnitAt
rules.conclusion: DecompositionBasis<W,C> x Referents<C> x Referents<W> -> Content
rules.reason: Recursive expansion of GunmaAt reaches the peer interface.

rules.subject: JaiRoleAdmissible
rules.reason: The JaiRaise mapping's constrained Context must be typed and pure.

rules.subject: InRegion
rules.reason: The pure row-directed Grade template reaches this declared interface.

rules.subject: Grade
rules.reason: The schema consumes its relation's declared degree projection, scale, and region without a site.

rules.subject: JaiRaise
rules.conclusion: row remapping plus role -> pure PredTerm<raised-row>
rules.reason: The schema consumes row metadata rather than inspecting predicate syntax.

rules.subject: context and index constants
rules.reason: Selected cases reach Host/attachment roles, generic modes, intensities, and evidential constants.

rules.subject: Polar/OpenQ/Ask
rules.conclusion: Content -> Query<Bool>; Content-valued function -> Query<A>; Query<A> -> Act<Question>
rules.reason: Selected Close cases occur beneath question constructors.

rules.subject: Local
rules.reason: Collection and performance specimens use the accessibility delimiter.

rules.subject: Perform
rules.reason: Selected discourse specimens spell the role explicitly.

rules.subject: Generic
rules.conclusion: GenericMode x Fn<T,Content> x EFn<T,Content> -> Content
rules.reason: Selected cases wrap supported Close expansions under generic quantification.

rules.subject: Named/Holds/display relations
rules.reason: Selected cases use the declared content-level interface relations around the expansion slice.

rules.subject: subtraction/AmountValue/abstraction rows
rules.conclusion: Number operations and typed abstraction relation rows
rules.reason: Selected cases embed Close under the numeric abstraction interfaces.

rules.subject: bound and derived PredTerm rows
rules.conclusion: row-directed partial filling preserves the residual PredTerm row
rules.reason: Close must consume typed bound and derived relation rows, not only fixture lexical heads.
